product_from_film: Cero presents a spending app with rewards, prize-like benefits, a score and a credit line.
explains_well: Repeated checkout scenes connect the app to everyday spending, while enlarged phone panels show benefits.
unclear: Eligibility, probabilities, fees and the relationship between rewards, salary doubling and credit are not explained.
scenario: Pay at shops, receive reward-like outcomes and improve a score that unlocks a credit line.
product_clear_basis: The paid-by-Cero phone result at 4s is followed by a checkout payment at 5s.

categories.finding: A purchase reward introduces packs/prizes, salary upside and a score-to-credit feature; checkout imagery links them.
A green token held in a hand becomes a small object above the street at 1–2s. It is a visual hook without a stated task yet.
Consumer spending is clear at 4–5s. The full app scope grows later through score and credit screens.
Token position, pack opening states, radial layouts, wheel values and circular photo crops provide repeated round motifs. Exact spins and easing are not resolved.
Retail footage alternates with white product/benefit cards. Circular crops unite several checkout scenes at the end.
Lime rays and glossy prize objects create a game-like treatment beside warm shop scenes.
Large prize and salary amounts dominate. The smaller terms or eligibility needed to interpret them are not visible in the sampled evidence.

categories.finding: Payment, rewards and score are visible silently. The meaning and conditions of each financial benefit remain unclear.
Bright green circles guide attention to the reward amount and score. Repeated retail scenes reset the context.
Multiple benefit types appear within 27s. A single spend-to-reward-to-score example would explain the relationship more clearly.
categories.experiment: Keep one purchase amount across the reward and score states.

categories.finding: The token and free-purchase opening promise upside; prizes and salary doubling extend that promise, while the closing repeats the spending theme.
Confetti, prizes and doubling values suggest excitement and anticipation; actual response is unmeasured.
Green circular forms and checkout hands stay consistent, but no one transaction is followed through all benefits.
Screens depict rewards, salary multiplication and a credit unlock. Availability, probability and financial terms are not independently established.
The green circular Cero mark and repeated round layouts give visual consistency; checkout footage is broadly reusable.
A checkout and corresponding reward establish utility. The megapot and salary wheel add claims before the score relationship is explained.
For Tin, connect one completed workflow to one visible result and one updated metric, using repeated circular highlights only where meaningful.

lessons.keep: Return to real-world use between feature graphics so the app stays tied to everyday action.
try: For Tin, alternate one real product shot with its campaign output and measurable result, retaining the same product throughout.
Use one simple gauge update after a completed workflow, with a clear label for what changed and why.
lessons.avoid: Stacking attractive benefit amounts without explaining their conditions or relationship.
lessons.open: Financial terms, eligibility, outcome probabilities, sound and precise motion remain unverified.
